name: grade-checker-serverless-e2e
description: End-to-end tests (Playwright) for the serverless version of Grade Checker

scripts.test:local: E2E_GITHUB_TOKEN=$(gh auth token) E2E_ADMIN_LOGIN=$(gh api user -q .login) playwright test
scripts.test:student: E2E_STUDENT=1 E2E_GITHUB_TOKEN=$(gh auth token) E2E_ADMIN_LOGIN=$(gh api user -q .login) playwright test
scripts.test:headed: E2E_GITHUB_TOKEN=$(gh auth token) E2E_ADMIN_LOGIN=$(gh api user -q .login) playwright test --headed
scripts.test:ui: E2E_GITHUB_TOKEN=$(gh auth token) E2E_ADMIN_LOGIN=$(gh api user -q .login) playwright test --ui
scripts.test:running: E2E_BASE_URL=${E2E_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:5173} E2E_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID=$(grep -s '^GITHUB_CLIENT_ID=' ../.env | cut -d= -f2-) E2E_GITHUB_TOKEN=$(gh auth token) playwright test
